calendarFeed.title: Calendar on your phone
calendarFeed.description: Subscribe to your calendar: your subgroups' classes and your deadlines appear and stay up to date in Google, Apple or Outlook.
calendarFeed.howTo: Google Calendar: Other calendars → From URL. Apple: File → New Calendar Subscription. Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web.
calendarFeed.private: The link is personal: it shows your timetable. Do not share it.

bot.help:
📚 *Commands:*

/start - Welcome and instructions
/link [token] - Link your account
/schedule - Today
/tomorrow - Tomorrow
/week - This week
/homework - My homework
/homework_due - Upcoming deadlines
/settings - Notification settings
/help - This help

💬 *Plain language:*
You can also just ask:
• "When is my next class?"
• "What do I have tomorrow?"
• "Show this week"
• "What homework do I have?"

🤖 The bot understands Russian and English.
